signal: Qualia added Axos Bank to its bank partner network in January 2026, expanding its digital closing ecosystem

email.body1:
Aren, saw Qualia added Axos Bank to its partner network to push more digital closings.

As the ecosystem grows, the bottleneck is rarely signal, it is the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting on it. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized, multi-channel outreach with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Qualia off your hiring and tech-stack signals. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through how it routes signal to action?
email.body2:
Aren, quick follow-up for Qualia.

Most RevOps teams I talk to lose pipeline to slow follow-up and patchy data hygiene, not a lack of accounts. Our built-in best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent before anything custom.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three concrete things I would change, and where the measurable lift usually comes from.
email.body3:
Aren, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to other proptech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Aren, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not on the roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. RevOps roadmaps fill up fast and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Qualia either way.
